emily (DevEx): quick heads-up 5: community reported parity mismatch between ruby and elixir SDKs on retry backoff semantics. ruby retries immediately, elixir uses jittered backoff. can we align? cc @nilesh @akar

nilesh (ruby-sdk): saw that. ruby's current RetryPolicy defaults were left intentionally aggressive for dev UX, but i agree parity is better. what's the community expectation?

tanya (community): users expect consistent behavior across languages. several bug reports mention surprise when retry floods a rate-limited endpoint. they prefer jittered exponential backoff like elixir.

akar (elixir-sdk): elixir implemented a max_attempts=3 with base=200ms and jitter. here's the snippet we use in the client: ```retry: {max_attempts: 3, base_ms: 200, multiplier: 2.0, jitter: true}```

nilesh (ruby-sdk): ok makes sense. i can submit a small change to ruby-sdk to adopt the same defaults and add a feature flag to preserve old behavior for testing. plan: add Retry::Policy.new(max_attempts:3, base_ms:200, multiplier:2.0, jitter:true) and update README + CHANGELOG.

emily (DevEx): thanks. can you also add a cross-sdk integration test that validates behavior on 429 responses? maybe a simple harness in samples/ that both SDKs use. prevents drift.

nilesh (ruby-sdk): good idea. i'll add an integration spec that spins up a tiny mux server returning 429 twice then 200, asserts client does not flood and succeeds within expected time window.

ci-bot: queued: ruby-sdk PR build (#485) on ubuntu-22. runner: linux-x64

akar (elixir-sdk): i'll mirror the test in the elixir repo once the ruby test shape is final. can we sync on exact timing thresholds so CI is stable?

tanya (community): keep thresholds loose. test should assert attempt count and eventual success, not exact ms. that avoids flaky CI.

nilesh (ruby-sdk): agreed. will assert attempts == 3 and response == expected. pushing PR now: github.com/redwood/ruby-sdk/pull/485

emily (DevEx): awesome, thanks. once merged, please add a short note in the sampleapp onboarding doc about the new defaults so users know why retries behave differently after upgrade.

nilesh (ruby-sdk): noted. i'll add upgrade note and a quick migration snippet to opt-out: `Redwood::Client.configure { |c| c.retry_policy = :legacy }`

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #485 1m ago. artifacts: spec-report.txt

emily (DevEx): great! closing loop with community who filed the issue. thanks everyone.
